bmx_raw <- readRDS("data/P_BMX.Rds")
bpxo_raw <- readRDS("data/P_BPXO.Rds")
demo_raw <- readRDS("data/P_DEMO.Rds")

<!--
____________________________________________________________________________________________
DATA DEVELOPMENT AND CLEANING
____________________________________________________________________________________________-->

```{r}
#| label: inspect-data
#| message: false
#| include: false

dim(demo_raw)
dim(bmx_raw)
dim(bpxo_raw)

names(demo_raw)
names(bmx_raw)
names(bpxo_raw)
```

```{r}
#| label: merge-data
#| message: false
#| include: false

analytic_raw <-
  demo_raw |>
  select(
    SEQN,
    RIDSTATR,
    RIDAGEYR,
    RIAGENDR,
    DMDEDUC2
  ) |>
  left_join(
    bmx_raw |>
      select(
        SEQN,
        BMXBMI
      ),
    by = "SEQN"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    bpxo_raw |>
      select(
        SEQN,
        BPXOSY1,
        BPXOSY2,
        BPXOSY3
      ),
    by = "SEQN"
  ) |>
  filter(
    RIDSTATR == "Both interviewed and MEC examined",
    RIDAGEYR >= 20,
    RIDAGEYR <= 79
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: clean-data
#| message: false
#| include: false


analytic_data <-
  analytic_raw |>
  mutate(
    avg_sbp = rowMeans(
      cbind(BPXOSY1, BPXOSY2, BPXOSY3),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    avg_sbp = if_else(is.nan(avg_sbp), NA_real_, avg_sbp),

    sex = factor(
      RIAGENDR,
      levels = c("Female", "Male")
    ),

    education = factor(
      case_when(
        DMDEDUC2 %in% c(
          "Less than 9th grade",
          "9-11th grade (Includes 12th grade with no diploma)"
        ) ~ "Less than HS",
        
        DMDEDUC2 == "High school graduate/GED or equivalent" ~ "HS Grad",
        
        DMDEDUC2 == "Some college or AA degree" ~ "Some College",
        
        DMDEDUC2 == "College graduate or above" ~ "College Grad",
        
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = c(
        "Less than HS",
        "HS Grad",
        "Some College",
        "College Grad"
      )
    ),

    obesity = factor(
      case_when(
        BMXBMI >= 30 ~ "Obese",
        BMXBMI < 30 ~ "Not obese",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = c("Not obese", "Obese")
    ),
    
    high_sbp = factor(
      case_when(
        avg_sbp >= 120 ~ "Elevated/High SBP",
        avg_sbp < 120 ~ "Normal SBP",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ),
      levels = c("Normal SBP", "Elevated/High SBP")
      )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: check-data
#| message: false
#| include: false


analytic_data |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    complete_sbp = sum(!is.na(avg_sbp)),
    complete_bmi = sum(!is.na(BMXBMI)),
    complete_all = sum(
      complete.cases(
        SEQN,
        RIDSTATR,
        RIDAGEYR,
        avg_sbp,
        BMXBMI,
        sex,
        education,
        obesity
      )
    ),
    min_age = min(RIDAGEYR, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_age = max(RIDAGEYR, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sbp_values = n_distinct(avg_sbp, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_bmi_values = n_distinct(BMXBMI, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

#  {.sidebar}

This dashboard summarizes systolic blood pressure data among adults aged 20–79 years in the 2017 – March 2020 pre-pandemic dataset from NHANES.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Source** | NHANES |
| **Cycle** | 2017–March 2020 |
| **Population** | Adults aged 20–79 years |
| **Total participants** | 7,968 |
| **Complete data** | 7,187 |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Sex

```{r}
#| label: analysis-b
#| results: hide
#| message: false
#| include: false

analysis_B <-
  analytic_data |>
  filter(
    !is.na(avg_sbp),
    !is.na(sex)
  )

analysis_B_summary <-
  analysis_B |>
  group_by(sex) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_sbp = mean(avg_sbp),
    sd_sbp = sd(avg_sbp),
    median_sbp = median(avg_sbp),
    IQR_sbp = IQR(avg_sbp),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

analysis_B_test <- t.test(
  avg_sbp ~ sex,
  data = analysis_B,
  conf.level = 0.90
)
```

# Education {orientation="columns"}

```{r}
#| label: analysis-c
#| include: false

analysis_C <-
  analytic_data |>
  filter(
    !is.na(avg_sbp),
    !is.na(education)
  )

# Education level
analysis_C_summary <-
  analysis_C |>
  group_by(education) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_sbp = mean(avg_sbp),
    sd_sbp = sd(avg_sbp),
    median_sbp = median(avg_sbp),
    IQR_sbp = IQR(avg_sbp),
    se_sbp = sd_sbp / sqrt(n),
    lower_90 = mean_sbp - qt(0.95, df = n - 1) * se_sbp,
    upper_90 = mean_sbp + qt(0.95, df = n - 1) * se_sbp,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# One-way ANOVA
analysis_C_model <-
  aov(avg_sbp ~ education, data = analysis_C)

# ANOVA results
analysis_C_anova <-
  summary(analysis_C_model)

# Tukey with 90% confidence intervals
analysis_C_tukey <-
  TukeyHSD(
    analysis_C_model,
    "education",
    conf.level = 0.90
  )

# Displaying Tukey output
analysis_C_tukey_table <-
  as.data.frame(analysis_C_tukey$education) |>
  rownames_to_column("comparison") |>
  rename(
    difference = diff,
    lower_90 = lwr,
    upper_90 = upr,
    p_value = `p adj`
  )

# Overall ANOVA p-value
analysis_C_p <-
  summary(analysis_C_model)[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]
```

### Tukey Comparisons

```{r}
#| title: "Tukey HSD Pairwise Comparisons"

analysis_C_tukey_table |>
  mutate(
    difference = round(difference, 2),
    lower_90 = round(lower_90, 2),
    upper_90 = round(upper_90, 2),
    p_value = case_when(
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p_value)
    )
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Comparison",
      "Mean Difference",
      "90% CI Lower",
      "90% CI Upper",
      "Adjusted p-value"
    )
  )
```

# Obesity

```{r}
#| label: analysis-d
#| include: false

analysis_D <-
  analytic_data |>
  filter(
    !is.na(obesity),
    !is.na(high_sbp)
  )

# 2 x 2 table
# Rows: exposure
# Columns: outcome
analysis_D_table <-
  table(
    factor(
      analysis_D$obesity,
      levels = c("Obese", "Not obese")
    ),
    factor(
      analysis_D$high_sbp,
      levels = c("Elevated/High SBP", "Normal SBP")
    )
  )

# Run 2 x 2 analysis
analysis_D_results <-
  Epi::twoby2(
    analysis_D_table,
    conf.level = 0.90
  )

# Counts and within-obesity proportions for plotting
analysis_D_summary <-
  analysis_D |>
  count(obesity, high_sbp) |>
  group_by(obesity) |>
  mutate(
    proportion = n / sum(n)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# Prevalence of elevated/high SBP
prevalence_obese <-
  analysis_D |>
  filter(obesity == "Obese") |>
  summarise(
    prevalence = mean(high_sbp == "Elevated/High SBP")
  ) |>
  pull(prevalence)

prevalence_not_obese <-
  analysis_D |>
  filter(obesity == "Not obese") |>
  summarise(
    prevalence = mean(high_sbp == "Elevated/High SBP")
  ) |>
  pull(prevalence)
```
